faqs.title: How do I reset my password?
faqs.details:
To reset your password:
1. Click on 'Forgot Password'
2. Enter your email
3. Follow the link in the email

faqs.title: How do I contact support?
faqs.details: You can reach our support team at support@example.com or call 1-800-SUPPORT.

faqs.title: What are the system requirements?
faqs.details: The app requires iOS 18 or later and macOS 15 or later.

faqs.title: How do I delete my account?
faqs.details: To delete your account, go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This action is permanent.

faqs.title: Is my data encrypted?
faqs.details: Yes, all data is encrypted using industry-standard AES-256 encryption both in transit and at rest.
